facts.fact: Drakken 先于所有人挡到她与 Xander 之间，一句「你在这儿」像丝绒裹着低吼：「我差点以为有人把你从我手底下偷走了，Max。」
facts.anchor: “There you are.” Drakken’s voice came out a vicious purr, all silk over a growl.

facts.fact: 她分辨出这并非两个情敌为一个奖品互咬，而是 Drakken 用身体挡在她和一个伸手认领的敌人之间。
facts.anchor: This was Drakken putting his body between me and an enemy reaching to stake a claim.

facts.fact: 她被迫接受跳舞，唯一的运气是戴着手套——没有皮肤接触。
facts.anchor: The one small mercy was the gloves. No skin against skin.

facts.fact: Xander 边舞边说：Missy 很好，已被他收为 ward（被监护人），什么都不缺，正数着日子等她。
他警告她不要被继承人骗：你不知道那些俊俏的脸下面是什么样的怪物——这句用在他自己身上更准。
facts.anchor: You’ve no idea what monsters wear those handsome faces.”

facts.fact: 他试图用意志压她，像油一样滑进颅骨内侧、把她的意志折服；寄居体只抬了一下肩，他的力量就像水从油钢上滑落——找不到门缝。
facts.anchor: A soft pressure against the inside of my skull, smooth as oil, his will sliding in to fold mine around it.

facts.fact: 她忍着污言收集碎屑，终于套出关键：Missy 在他的宫殿里，旧城 Houston。
facts.anchor: he’d let slip the one thing I needed: Missy was in his palace, in the old city they called Houston.

facts.fact: 他当众宣布这场舞不是和某个女孩跳，是和他的未婚妻跳——不许任何人碰他的未来王后。
facts.anchor: I’m dancing with my betrothed. And I won’t allow a single soul to lay hands on my future queen.

facts.fact: 他当众把她的名字拆开念：Lady Max Morning-star——Scorpio 与 Capricorn 两家的失落继承人，出生前就被许给他，几周大时被偷走藏匿，二十年cloak 失效才被感知。
facts.anchor: Lady Max Morning”—he let the name break, the pause deliberate—“star.

facts.fact: 血契原文：他以婚姻与王后之位娶那女孩——Princess Trivia Morningstar。
facts.anchor: takes to wife and queen the girl-child born of House Scorpio and House Capricorn, Princess Trivia Morningstar.

facts.fact: 契约右下角的第二个名字：Hecate，Scorpio 家族之首——正是白女巫。
Aelindor 在她最恐惧的时候定调：什么都没变，Max 是我们的——过去是，将来也是，她是 Zodiac Covenant 的女儿。
facts.anchor: “Nothing changes.” Aelindor’s voice dropped and pulled me back. “Max is ours. She always was. She always will be.

facts.fact: Xander 划开自己的左前臂，同一瞬她的同位置也裂开流血——血契已激活，她与他性命相连。
facts.anchor: a gash had opened in my skin

facts.fact: 他解释为何当众展示：你们不能杀我而不在同一刀里杀死 Max——杀了我就等于杀了她。
facts.anchor: you cannot kill me without killing Max in the same stroke.
